256	the nature of this angel being discussed here

257	in Parashat Mishpatim, in our parashah: "Behold, I send

258	an angel" — it is an emphasis that after you receive the Torah

259	you will continue to the Land of Israel and you will have

261	an angel who comes out of the Holy One, blessed be He,

262	being angry, as after the sin of the calf, when He says, I will not

263	be with you, I am sending a messenger, and then Moshe says to Him,

265	want You to be with us too. Here this is still before

266	the sin of the calf, as I emphasized.

267	And there is an angel here, as there was with Avraham, an angel,

268	and with Yitzchak an angel, and with Yaakov an angel, without any sin

269	of any kind.

270	That is, we must make the distinction here

271	regarding the angel: the guardian angel is a different

272	angel. He does not come out of

273	a reaction to a state of anger, God forbid, as there was after

274	the calf. This is what needs to be understood now. In truth,

275	this angel is not actually mentioned for the first time
